A pivot hinge system by FritsJurgens consists of a pivot hinge in the bottom of the door and a top pivot in the top of the door or in the ceiling. The top pivot is the top side of the pivot point and anchors the pivot door in the ceiling.

FritsJurgens offers various floor plates to match the pivot hinge of your choice and the design of your pivot door. Take a look at the different options in shape and material for each FritsJurgens pivot hinge system.

FritsJurgens offers several accessories for the use and installation of your pivot door. Make the installation of the pivot door even easier with the Hexagon Guide, and the Axle Wrench, align your pivot doors perfectly with the FritsJurgens Flush.

Soft-close at the end of the closing cycle. The door arrives at the frame quietly, without slam.
Adjusts the closing speed through the final 30° to the 0° position, so the door returns at a measured pace instead of rushing the last stretch.
An additional acceleration in the last few degrees, so the door closes firmly into the latch or lock.
Built into the door, felt in the room

Thanks to Damper Control and 30° Speed Control together, the System M+ pivot hinge closes on its own. After being opened, it moves back to the 0° position through one continuous, elegant motion, so the door never stands ajar and never needs pulling shut.
Thanks to 30° Speed Control, the door comes to rest in a single fluent motion, as soft as a whisper, so it never slams and never disturbs the quiet of a room.
Damper Control’s hydraulic backcheck slows the door strongly when reaching 70°, preventing it from touching the wall.
Double acting, holding at 0°, 90° or -90° in either direction, so you decide exactly how open, or closed off, a space feels.
With the touch of a finger
Set into motion with the touch of a finger, an effortless, perfectly balanced movement.
What a System M+ set contains
A complete set consists of four parts. The pivot hinge sits in the door, the plates anchor it to floor and ceiling.
Fitted in the ceiling; the top pivot pin fits into it. Available in brushed stainless steel and black.
Mounted into the top of the door via a pinhole connection. Available in Class B and Class G, and as Top pivot Reversed. The Class G version carries a Ø7.5 mm cable entry for wiring through the door.

The pivot mechanism and driver of the door, fitted in the bottom side, virtually invisible. Load bearing capacity up to 500 kg. Offers hold positions, self-closing, damper control, latch control, 30° speed control, free swing, depending on the choice of bottom pivot.
Fixed with 8 mm mounting pins, so it can be combined with floor heating. Squared and round come in stainless steel and black; Flush recesses into the door frame and comes in stainless steel.
* Shown: System M+ 70 mm. Other options available.
Seven cautious choices move a 500 kg door in silence.
The bottom pivot named above is where this happens. Here is what sits inside it, and why each part is built the way it is.
Holds steady. Milled from a single solid block of aluminium, it carries the whole door without flexing, so the movement always begins from something true.
Stays true. High-strength brackets hold the system precisely where it meets the floor, so the door keeps the line it was set to.
Closes with calm. High-strength pressure springs and a double oil damper guide the door through its entire arc, bringing even a heavy one to a soft, unhurried close.
Double oil damper · springs to 4,300 N · Class G
Glides, year after year. A low-friction coating lets the moving parts pass almost without resistance, so the swing stays smooth far into daily use.
Never wears. The part that meets the force of every open and close is hardened steel, so the door holds its precise feel instead of loosening over time.
Makes weight feel light. Three bearings share the load between them, spreading the weight so evenly that a substantial door turns at the touch of a hand.
Two radial, one axial · up to 500 kg
Can be tuned to your door. Three screws set the soft close, the closing speed and the latching to your exact door, and reset them, years on, if anything changes.

At 18 mm high and 32 mm wide, System One fits doors from 40 mm thick. It has no hold positions and no self-closing, which keeps the mechanism simple and suits a wide range of door designs. For steel and aluminium profiles there is
The door turns freely in both directions. That simplicity makes System One easy to combine with door frames.
System One rotates freely: single-acting to 90°, double-acting to 180°, or a full 360° as a revolving door.
What a System One set contains
A complete set consists of four parts. The pivot hinge sits in the door, the plates anchor it to floor and ceiling.
The ceiling plate is fitted in the ceiling and takes the pin of the top pivot. System One uses the ceiling plate Class G: 70 × 40 × 23 mm, for a Ø15 mm pin, in stainless steel or black.

The top pivot is mounted in the top of the door with a pinhole connection. It adjusts 5 mm to the left and 5 mm to the right and has a Ø7.5 mm cable entry. System One 70 mm pairs with Top pivot 70 mm Class G, or with Top pivot Reversed, which is installed in the head jamb with the Receiver. The 40 mm build pairs with Top pivot 40 mm Class G.

The pivot mechanism sits in the bottom of the door, where it is virtually invisible. At 162 × 32 × 18 mm, System One carries doors up to 500 kg (Class G). It is a free-swing system with no hold positions and no self-closing, so the door turns freely through 360°.

This is the floor plate made for System One. Two or four 8 mm mounting pins hold it in place, or two 30 mm pins on layered floor materials, so it combines with underfloor heating. It comes in stainless steel.
* Shown: System One 70 mm with floor plate squared non-adjustable. Other options available.

System One takes four floor plates. The floor plate squared non-adjustable is made for System One: 80 × 40 × 9 mm, an 11 mm undercut, no radial adjustment, in stainless steel. The round floor plate adds 2.5° of radial adjustment to either side. Flush squared and Flush rounded are recessed into the sill, for drop seals and exterior pivot doors.

Does System One have hold positions or self-closing?
No. System One is a free-swing pivot hinge: the door turns freely, without hold positions and without self-closing. For hold positions, see
Which floor plate do I need for System One?

System One takes four floor plates. The floor plate squared non-adjustable is made for System One. The round floor plate also offers 2.5° of radial adjustment to either side. If you plan drop seals or an exterior pivot door, choose Flush squared or Flush rounded, which are recessed into the sill.
Can System One be used for a revolving door?
Yes. System One rotates a full 360°, and also works for single-acting (90°) and double-acting (180°) pivot doors.
Which top pivot pairs with System One?
System One 70 mm pairs with Top pivot 70 mm Class G or with Top pivot Reversed, which is installed in the head jamb with the Receiver. System One 40 mm pairs with Top pivot 40 mm Class G.

System 3 offers rotation all around, while maintaining features like self-closure and hold positions.
From every 45° angle, System 3 rotates automatically towards its hold positions at 0°, 90°, 180° or 270°.
360° rotation combined with hold positions and self-closure are ideal features for pivoting walls.

The ceiling plate is fitted in the ceiling, where the pin of the top pivot seamlessly fits into the hole in the ceiling plate. The ceiling plate is available in two finishes: brushed stainless steel and black.

The top pivot is mounted into the top of the door. It uses a so-called pinhole connection, in which the pin is fixed to the top pivot and goes into the hole in the ceiling plate when the door is placed.
Every FritsJurgens floor plate is mounted 8 mm in the floor. This is sufficient for almost every floor type and makes it possible to combine FritsJurgens’ hinges with floor heating.

There are two floor plate designs available for System 3. You can choose for a round floor plate or a square floor plate in brushed stainless steel (Series 420). The floor plates by FritsJurgens are made of solid tempered steel and, therefore, entirely scratch resistant.

The FritsJurgens System 3 bottom pivot is a powerful pivot mechanism designed for 360° rotation, ideal for central pivot installations. Installed in the bottom side of the door, it remains almost invisible. This robust system supports pivot doors weighing up to 500 kg, ensuring smooth and reliable operation. System 3 guides the door to the nearest hold position at every 90° interval, with a total of four hold positions per full rotation.

What is new about System Fx?
The strong hold positions of System Fx is what set it apart from our other pivot hinges. The name Fx comes from fix, meaning the door is fixed in place due to the strong hold positions.
Does System Fx have damping or soft-close?
System Fx does not offer damping or soft-close. This is offered exclusively by System M+.

Radiant floor heating and a pivot door work well together. The heating is usually installed about 5 cm below the floor surface, and a FritsJurgens floor plate goes only 8 mm deep.

A FritsJurgens floor plate can sit on a single floor type or bridge two different ones. The drilling template marks where the 8 mm pins go into the floor. On layered floor materials, the squared floor plates can be mounted with two 30 mm pins instead.
A flush look on interior floors
Floor plate Flush can be milled into an interior floor, even where there is no threshold. It then sits level with the floor and leaves only 7 mm of space under the door.

Floor plate Flush is electropolished. Electricity and chemicals dissolve the contamination on the surface and form a new, even chromium oxide layer that is much thicker than the original. That layer makes the surface extremely resistant to corrosion, more than any other surface treatment can, and easier to clean.

Floor plate Flush comes in two versions, with rounded or squared corners. Which one to use depends on how the floor plate is built into the threshold. It sits flush with the threshold and takes up no more space than necessary, leaving only 7 mm under the door, so the drop seal only has a short gap to close.

Our core business consists of designing and manufacturing beautiful, innovative, and easy to install high-end architectural pivot systems. Systems that can support doors of nearly any material, weighing up to 500 kg, with a width of 4 meters and unlimited height.

In everything we do, we believe in providing an authentic experience. An experience that exceeds expectations at every FritsJurgens interaction. We achieve this by always going the extra mile, never compromising on quality, and paying meticulous attention to every single detail.

The story of FritsJurgens begins as early as 1930. During those often dire times, our namesake took responsibility for the craftsmen at the largest shipyard in the Netherlands. Widely known for his keen eye for technical perfection, he oversaw their work and output. His philosophy resonated clear and true:
“The perfect design is innovative, functional, beautiful, and usable.”

Today, as the third generation of Frits Jurgens, we are not only proud that his legacy continues to echo through our work, but we also strive to live by those words every single day. His belief in the timeless beauty of hidden perfection remains our guiding principle. For now, and always.

Perfection is an elusive thing, and, like all things, subject to change. From the very beginning, we have aimed to achieve perfection not only in what we create but also in what we provide. We are proud to say that we have succeeded. However, as with everything, time changes the perception of perfection. Like our systems, it moves smoothly but unmistakably.

That is why we continue to focus on innovating and improving our designs and methodologies. Thus, even though the initial FritsJurgens hinges may resemble the current ones, there have been significant changes—changes that once again strive to achieve the perfection we envision.
Our vision of the future starts today

We are driven by our vision for the future—a vision in which architects, designers, and makers get the opportunity to bring their creativity to life. Creativity that has the power to redefine movement and transform an idea into something tangible and beautiful.
By providing them with invisible and invincible hardware, there are no limits to the possibilities. We work diligently to realize this vision of the future today.
